# Onefifty

> Onefifty is a pop-rock band from Yogyakarta, Indonesia, formed in 2022 by academicians of Universitas AMIKOM Yogyakarta, The Creative Economy Park. The band plays campus events, graduations, orientations and public stages, and stages themed shows where brands are seen in use, tried and shared by the audience. Headline: "Orang tidak membeli yang diiklankan. Mereka membeli yang mereka lihat dipakai." (People don't buy what is advertised. They buy what they see being used.) Tagline: "Iklan dilewati. Momen diingat." (Ads get skipped. Moments get remembered.)

## Brand collaboration

Positioned as an alternative to KOL/influencer marketing: instead of sponsored content audiences can scroll past, the product is used live on stage while the audience sings along, tried on the spot, and shared through clips, with measurable results.


- Moments the band plays: welcomes (new student orientation, welcome parties), celebrations (graduations, launches, mall stages), and gatherings (Syawalan, kenduri, company gatherings).
- Themed shows for communities already emotionally tied to the theme: Nostalgia Game, Slow Rock 90-an (90s slow rock), AI Music Showcase.
- How it works: the audience sees the product used on stage by people like them (seen), tries it through song voting, vouchers and giveaways (tried), and keeps the moment alive through studio sessions and short clips they share themselves (shared). Votes, redeemed vouchers, giveaway entries and shared clips are counted (measured).
- Pricing: Paket Momen, starting from Rp3 million per event (product used on stage, song voting/voucher/giveaway activation, studio session and short clips). Final price depends on the event and activation.
- Next show: Nostalgia Game. Limited collaboration slots for coffee, PC and gaming gear brands. Contact via WhatsApp +62 821-3612-3205 (https://wa.me/6282136123205) or Instagram @onefifty.band.

## The name
The name comes from Asisten Ahli 150, the first academic rank (Jabatan Fungsional Akademik) of an Indonesian lecturer and the gate to a professional academic career. It stands for growth: as the members grow as academicians and as musicians, they want to bring a positive and significant impact to life.

## Members

- Arif Akbarul Huda: ML/AI Engineer; music producer
- Arifiyanto Hadinegoro: Soft Computing; guitar, bass, drums
- Agit Amrullah: Computer Vision; bass or guitar
- Muhammad Tofa Nurcholis: Game Development; vocals
- Anggit Ferdita Nugraha: Programmer; drums
- Rifda Faticha: UI/UX Researcher; vocals
- Fajar Sigit Purnomo: Computer Network Engineer; bass
- Nadea Cipta Laksmita: AI Music; keyboard, music producer
- Muhammad Najih Fasya: Urban & Regional Planning Researcher; vocals

The lineup rotates between events.
